subject.title: test(repair): add hermetic automerge end-to-end flow

question: Should this repository’s recurring CI be permitted to execute the digest-pinned `masonxhuang/clawsweeper-automerge-e2e-base` image, or must the E2E base be built/published through a repository-controlled, attestable path?
rationale: A digest establishes immutability, not who built or reviewed the executable base layer. Accepting a personal-namespace image as CI infrastructure is a repository security and supply-chain boundary decision.

options.title: Use a repository-controlled base
options.body: Build `Dockerfile.base` in the workflow or publish it from a repository-controlled release path with verifiable provenance before enabling the recurring E2E job.

options.title: Accept the pinned external base
options.body: Explicitly accept the external digest as the CI trust root and document its ownership, update process, and provenance expectations.

recommendation.title: Use a repository-controlled base
recommendation.body: Build `Dockerfile.base` in the workflow or publish it from a repository-controlled release path with verifiable provenance before enabling the recurring E2E job.
